maya: Morning — Day 1 check-in
what I did: finished cloud signup, pulled repo, tried to start the dev container
blockers: VPN won't connect; Docker permissions error when running dev container
what I'll do today: pair with @jon on infra fixes, finish quickstart tutorial

jon: Welcome, maya! I'll ping IT and invite you to the infra channel.
Quick try: run `sudo usermod -aG docker $USER` then log out / back in. Also try `docker run hello-world` to validate.

aisha: Hi @maya, I reset your VPN token and whitelisted your IP. Try reconnecting now and reply here if it still fails.

maya: Reconnected to VPN — success. Docker still gives a permission denied when starting the dev container:
```
docker: Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied
```
I'm blocked on running `devbox up` because of that.

chris_dev: For repo access I sent a GitHub invite to your email. For the devbox, we usually run as non-root via the dev user. Try:
```
# add docker group and relogin
sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker
```
If that doesn't work, run `sudo devbox up` as a temporary workaround and we'll sort perms.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete HR forms (link: https://hr.redwood.example/forms) and the security training by EOD Friday. :memo:

jon: If perms still block you, we can pair at 3pm PT today. I'll DM the Zoom link.

maya: Thanks everyone — VPN + invite fixed, trying the `newgrp docker` trick now. Will confirm in a bit. :thumbsup:
